description: BPL Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells consumer electronics durable products in India. It offers televisions, washing machines, TV speakers and soundbars, refrigerator, air-conditioner, wireless products, cables and cords, fan, computer networking cables, party speakers, bluetooth neckbands, and headphones and headsets; single, double, and multi-layer printed circuit boards; and medical technologies. The company sells its products under the BPL brand. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Palakkad, India.
